title: melica ciliata subsp. glauca
intro: Melica ciliata subsp. glauca, commonly known as Mountain Barley, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to aid in digestion and provide relief from gastrointestinal issues, thereby showcasing its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Melica ciliata subsp. glauca are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its calming effects on the body. The bioactive constituents present in the plant are flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
